concerns.text: Functional Requirement FR‑009 (abort on missing required fields) is not referenced anywhere in the Phase Overview table or elsewhere in the plan. The spec mandates a clear abort with an informative error when any input record lacks required fields, but the plan never mentions implementing or testing this behavior.

Success Criterion SC‑005 (no input record triggers a missing‑field error) is absent from the plan’s FR/SC mapping. The plan does not describe how the system will be validated to ensure that all required fields are present and that missing‑field errors are correctly raised.
